notes.title: The Neat & Tidy Update is now live on PC and consoles!

items.text: After spending some time on the Experimental Branch and getting a final round of testing, the update is ready to roll out. Thank you to everyone who jumped in early, tested the new features, reported bugs, and shared feedback with us.

And there’s another big milestone: this update launches simultaneously on PC and consoles. With it, all versions of Cash Cleaner Simulator are now caught up and feature the same content across platforms.

This update brings the new LootVac Multi-Cleaner, the World Banknote Compendium, new furniture and decorations, rare collectible sets, quality-of-life improvements, and plenty of fixes across the game.
Added the LootVac Multi-Cleaner, which can quickly clean up messes and unpack stacks of bills. It works with coins, bills, and rubbish and is now available on the Black Market.

The message button for character orders is now hidden if there are no messages from that character in the DarkNet app.
Improved unpack behavior for the Marked Bills Sorter so the pack falls ahead after manipulation.
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where some strings were not translated after switching languages until the game was restarted.
Fixed several typos and improved wording throughout the game.
Punching Bags spawned in random quests will no longer have dirty or wet states.
Fixed an issue where new items were chained together when spawning.
Fixed an issue where new items could still be purchased when out of stock.
Fixed an issue where a bill could be seen inside money counters.
Fixed the Platform Trolley’s unusual physics behavior.
Fixed an issue where inventory objects spawned in the center of the level when the player picked up the cat.
Fixed several UI issues on money counters when loading a saved game.
Fixed an issue with random collectibles spawning too many identical pound notes.
Fixed issues with the market orders list.
Fixed a random visual bug affecting noise and lighting when loading a save.
Fixed an issue with the secret log’s time-skip mechanic when the player stood up.
Fixed an issue where the Conveyor didn’t accept an order if it had been packed directly on the Conveyor.
Fixed the Stop button behavior for small money counters.
Fixed a circular visual bug on Money counters L.
Fixed an issue where the Furnace flame disappeared if the player quickly turned it off and back on.
With Update VI, we’ve reached the end of the roadmap we set out to complete.

We’ll continue supporting Cash Cleaner Simulator, fixing bugs, and listening to your feedback. Even when we don’t reply, we’re still reading, watching, and keeping your ideas in mind. Who knows, some of those ideas may one day give us a reason to return with another big update.
For now, after almost three years with Cash Cleaner, our team is shifting its main focus to a brand new game.

We also want to highlight the amazing modding community. If you’re looking for even more Cash Cleaner, community-made mods can open up new ways to play and take the game beyond its original boundaries.
And a huge thank you to everyone contributing to the Cash Cleaner Simulator Wiki, helping players discover, understand, and document everything the game has to offer 💙
The Cash Cleaner Simulator Team 💸

notes.title: You’ve been asking what’s inside the box… and today’s the day.

items.text: Meet Jock Oops 🐱 A cat. Betty’s beloved little boy. Her best friend. And now… yours.
She couldn’t take him with her, so she’s trusting you with her most important treasure. No pressure, but you’re her second favorite person after all.
Jock brings a bit of life into your workspace. Keeps things from feeling too quiet. Too empty. You know… just in case you ever felt like you were doing all this alone.
And if you decide to make his life a little more comfortable, you’ll find everything you need on the Black Market.
Don’t worry though, he’s a very good boy. He won’t make a mess. He won’t cause chaos.
He’ll just be there. Sometimes busy with his own cat things.
*And if you ever feel like going solo, you can turn him off in the settings
Since the 1.0 release, we’ve added quite a few new activities and features to the game… but they didn’t have achievements. And we know you’ve been waiting for them. Honestly, so have we.
With this update, we’ve added 14 new achievements tied to content introduced after 1.0. Time to go back and complete what you started.

items.text: First of all, a big thank you to everyone who participated in the Experimental playtests and shared their feedback with us. Your reports, suggestions, and patience helped us improve many things in this update.
You are the best ❤️
£ British Pounds currency is here!
Four new GBP banknotes and four new GBP coins! You can start finding them after level 15, introduced through the special character SIR-9000 and his short intro story.
The new GBP Money Counter!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/b02e2373f25fd4fc89f73729dfd6f0beb49847dd.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/5100429f7994b09c13e4550fed5c715752cfdc51.gif"]
Wall mounting! A new mechanic that lets you place Compendiums, TVs, and other wall decorations directly on walls!
TV with quest details and Compendiums have been added to the Black Market.
You can buy them and place as many as you like!
New decor Skate Deck Art Series (3 items) added to the Black Market
*We are continuing to work on more wall-mountable content, so expect more in future updates!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/79b394167288b58672cdfa7faaa76e60a79313d7.gif"]
8 new types of containers in different colors. Some are available in the Black Market, while others are quite rare and can be found in random orders.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/1553a463c917a7600cf4b23245b0caf5e8659f6c.jpg"]
Added two new shelving units with drawers (small and big) for those who don’t like to keep everything in sight
Now the game uses Steam even if it is launched outside of Steam (via exe file or another launcher). This should help ensure DLCs and mods work together properly, for example.
Balance changes
More optional quests for each level
All Money Counters and Marked Bills sorter are now cheaper
Money Counter XXL now unlocks at level 17
Lift-Platform now unlocks one level earlier
Euro and Yen bills appear slightly earlier
Some other items are now a bit cheaper
Workbench Foam now contains twice as much in one pack
Minor changes to the rarity of some containers and other items
Minor improvements to order delivery sounds, so you can hear them anywhere on the level
Some story quest goals were reworked to make them easier to read and complete
Added Korean language (beta).
We collected feedback during the experimental version, but we are still improving the localization. If you play in Korean, please share your impressions with us!
Fixed a rare issue where the conveyor could randomly return to its initial position
Fixed several rare issues with the Autopay machine gun
When money visually disappeared after collecting it from a suitcase
When Money Counters stopped working after interaction with the Autopay gun
Fixed a visual bug where some objects appeared too dark in the inventory
Fixed an issue where coins or coin stacks on the floor could not be clicked
Fixed the “Two cases” quest white money issue
Fixed an issue where unpacking a trash bag could spawn trash in a different place if it was cut in the inventory
Fixed an issue where package weight changed if you emptied it while holding it
Fixed an issue where money on the Workbench could hang in the air
Added Yen and Euro Money Counters ten bills option (like other counters already have)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971449/6ade72c865d7977563d4b6ac4142b39e1004e8e6.png"]
With this update we have delivered most of the features originally planned for Update IV in the roadmap.
💷 British Pounds (£) are now in the game, along with the GBP bills sorting machine, and we’ve also added more types of bags and containers in different colors.

During development we considered a new quest type - Storage, but it didn’t feel like a good fit for the game, so we decided to cut it. Instead, we’re working on another nice feature. We’re not ready to reveal it just yet, but we’re excited to show it to you soon.

💸 You might also notice that Decorative Wall Posters made their way into the game earlier than originally planned. They were originally scheduled for Update V, but we felt they fit perfectly with the new wall mounting mechanics, so we decided to include them in this update.
💰 We’ve decided to include one more QoL Update (QoL 4). As always, we carefully read your feedback and try to include the improvements the community asks for the most.
Also, we’re preparing a small surprise for you. Stay tuned! 👌🏻
The Cash Cleaner Simulator Team 💸
